integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the full primary preprint, its exact leaf parametrization and transverse Lipschitz inequality, plus a direct invariant-measure argument on the leaf circle. The older annulus integrability literature was compared as a distinct, non-covering regime. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem retains the transverse Lipschitz-foliation assumption and does not prove that the foliation supplied by the motivating theorem has that stronger regularity. Area preservation is used essentially to obtain an invariant transverse marginal. The result does not cover merely non-wandering twist maps.
title: Lipschitz foliations alone force minimality for irrational twist maps
